critical_code_review_comments: Inline styles on vehicule.html grids (grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr) rely on !important override via .stack-sm at <=600px; works but consider moving grid definition entirely to CSS class for cleaner cascade.
spec() helper hardcodes label width:110px; combined with padding, this exactly caused the earlier overflow. Consider making it flex with min-width:0 for future-proofing.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration_6 had residual ~92px overflow on vehicule.html at 390px. Fix (adding .stack-sm on Caractéristiques grid) is confirmed. All 10 mobile pages (index, location, services entretien/pieces, reservation, vehicule, compte, pro, loueur, admin) show scrollWidth==innerWidth==390 (overflow=0). Desktop 1280px: vehicule.html Caractéristiques grid=327px 327px, Conditions grid=312px 312px (2 cols preserved).
rca of the issue: RCA (fixed): The 'Caractéristiques' grid on vehicule.html used inline style grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr with no responsive class. Combined with the spec() helper's fixed 110px label + numeric value, content forced a min row width > 195px per column at 390px viewport, causing ~92px horizontal overflow. Mitigation: added class 'stack-sm' on both the Caractéristiques grid (line 28) and Conditions card (line 34); style.css @media(max-width:600px) applies grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)!important, collapsing to a single column. Verified via document.documentElement.scrollWidth<=innerWidth+2 across all pages.
